facilities_rooms_capacity_nonnegative_ch.name: facilities_rooms_capacity_nonnegative_check
facilities_rooms_capacity_nonnegative_ch.value:
("facilities_rooms"."maximum_student_capacity" is null or "facilities_rooms"."maximum_student_capacity" >= 0)
        and ("facilities_rooms"."current_available_student_capacity" is null or "facilities_rooms"."current_available_student_capacity" >= 0)

facilities_rooms_available_capacity_chec.name: facilities_rooms_available_capacity_check
facilities_rooms_available_capacity_chec.value:
"facilities_rooms"."current_available_student_capacity" is null
        or "facilities_rooms"."maximum_student_capacity" is null
        or "facilities_rooms"."current_available_student_capacity" <= "facilities_rooms"."maximum_student_capacity"

inventory_discrepancies_review_check.name: inventory_discrepancies_review_check
inventory_discrepancies_review_check.value:
("inventory_discrepancies"."reviewer_id" is null and "inventory_discrepancies"."reviewed_at" is null and "inventory_discrepancies"."review_note" is null)
      or
      ("inventory_discrepancies"."reviewer_id" is not null and "inventory_discrepancies"."reviewed_at" is not null and "inventory_discrepancies"."review_note" is not null)

inventory_transaction_line_item_check.name: inventory_transaction_line_item_check
inventory_transaction_line_item_check.value:
("inventory_transaction_lines"."asset_id" is not null and "inventory_transaction_lines"."consumable_id" is null and "inventory_transaction_lines"."quantity" is null)
    or ("inventory_transaction_lines"."asset_id" is null and "inventory_transaction_lines"."consumable_id" is not null and "inventory_transaction_lines"."quantity" is not null and "inventory_transaction_lines"."quantity" <> 0)
